messages:
Ben (platform): Quick sync — proposing a small cross-team contract for request correlation + tiered sampling so the Console can show accurate p95/p99 + error counts by request origin. Need runtime + infra + obs + product alignment.

Alice (api): +1. Can you outline the header name and minimal shape? Also what's the perf impact?

Ben (platform): Header: `X-Redwood-Req` (UUID v4). We also want to attach `span_id` and `trace_id` when available. Perf: runtime perf hit should be negligible if we treat it as metadata (no sync disk). Sampling determines volume.

Carla (runtime): Implementation notes: runtime will accept `X-Redwood-Req` or generate one. We'll attach to outgoing model calls and logs. We'll add a small enum label for `route` and `model_bucket` to the emitted spans to reduce cardinality in the Dashboards.

Dave (observability): Want to make sure sampled traces can be linked from Console dashboards. Proposal for sampling policy (rough):
```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"match": "error", "rate": 1.0},
    {"match": "tag:critical-route", "rate": 0.5},
    {"match": "default", "rate": 0.01}
  ],
  "header": "X-Redwood-Req"
}
```
This keeps noise down but guarantees errors are fully captured.

Alice (api): How do we mark a request as `critical-route`? We have many internal clients. We could set a per-route metadata flag in the ingress layer.

Ben (platform): yes — routing layer (api gateway) should set `route_tag=api.v1.generate` and `tier=dedicated|hosted`. Console will roll up by `route_tag`.

Carla (runtime): Two runtime constraints: 1) avoid exploding metric cardinality — only allow a curated `route_tag` whitelist (20-30 top routes), otherwise map to `other`. 2) KV cache keys: don't include full request id. Use request id only in logs/traces; cache keys stay short.

Emma (product): UX needs: clicking a row in the errors table should open the trace or logs for that `X-Redwood-Req`. So the header must be present end-to-end and stable. Also want a canary UX: be able to toggle `sampling` to 100% for a given rollout window.

Dave (observability): For canary toggles we can add a rollout tag: `sampling_override=true` pushed by Console to the sampling service. That allows 100% sampling for targeted prefixes at runtime.

Alice (api): Security question: are we permitting cross-service spoofing of `X-Redwood-Req`? We should prefer the gateway overwrite on ingress and ignore upstream-supplied header unless signed.

Carla (runtime): Agreed. Runtime will trust downstream header only if it passes a short HMAC check from the gateway; otherwise runtime generates a new one. HMAC key rotation handled by infra KMS.

Ben (platform): Good — summary action items: 1) Carla -> runtime changes to accept/generate header + span enrichments (owner: Carla) 2) Alice -> gateway to set `route_tag` and enforce gateway-overwrite policy (owner: Alice) 3) Dave -> sampling service + Console hooks for canary toggles + trace linking (owner: Dave) 4) Emma/Product -> define top-20 `route_tag` whitelist (owner: Emma)

Carla (runtime): I'll open PR for runtime header handling and a small benchmark (expected CPU <0.5%).

Alice (api): I'll add gateway overwrite + HMAC and a patch to route metadata.

Dave (observability): I'll prototype the sampling rules and Console toggle page. Will need a short API from runtime to flag an active canary prefix.

infra-bot: Action created: infra/keys -> rotation ticket #INC-4821 (link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-4821) :gear:

Emma (product): Nice. Timeline? Can we aim for an initial internal rollout next week (canary with 1 host)?

Ben (platform): Let's aim for canary next Tue. Carla/Alice/Dave — ping me when PRs are ready and I'll coordinate the Console change. :thumbsup:

Carla (runtime): pinged about the PR in #eng-releases when ready.

Dave (observability): noted. I'll include a quick query to join metrics by `X-Redwood-Req` for debugging.

Ben (platform): Thanks everyone. If anyone hits blockers DM me.
